def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Remove exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates().reset_index(drop=True)
    # Fix species label variants (lowercase -> proper case)
    df['species'] = df['species'].str.strip().str.capitalize()
    # Fix island label variants (truncated names)
    df['island'] = df['island'].replace({'Bisco': 'Biscoe', 'Dram': 'Dream'})
    # Fix negative flipper lengths (likely sign errors)
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = df['flipper_length_mm'].abs()
    return df

def answer(df):
    result = df.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].sum()
    return result.to_dict()
